answer: A durable defense is to make each identity post a refundable work bond tied to a verifiable history, like basalt foundations under an island settlement: newcomers earn standing only by completing useful, peer-graded work over time, and that standing cannot be transferred or cloned. A river of cheap new accounts then buys nothing, because an attacker must pay the full time-and-work cost for every fake identity while honest agents keep their accumulated reputation.
